newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Bank of the Ozarks.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Bank of the Ozarks.

text.p: Bank of the Ozarks Inc filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering of up to 1,331,700 common shares, of which the company will sell 700,000 shares and a group of current shareholders will sell 631,700 shares.
The Little Rock, Arkansas, bank holding company said it expects the shares to sell between $14 and $16 each.
Underwriters for the offering, Stephens Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 199,755 shares.
The company said the proceeds it receives from the sale, an estimated $5 million, will be used for general corporate purposes including capital investments in the company's subsidiary banks.
After the offering, the company will have 3,579,800 shares outstanding.
